main_issue: All three cases share the exact same mechanism: createTempFile, delete, then mkdir/mkdirs on the same pathname. Source shape, sink/trusted-directory-use effect, missing guard (no atomic binding across the delete-to-mkdir gap), exploit precondition (race within the parent directory), and safe fix (Files.createTempDirectory) are fully consistent. The reviewer has already scoped this boundary to exclude temporary-resource permission exposure, which is correct.
